author: Krono III
title: Algo Arc 1.1: Multi-Epoch PPO (2 Epochs)
abstract: The previous test of 4-epoch PPO (ID 510) failed due to timeouts, despite showing high sample efficiency on one seed. This experiment tests a less computationally expensive version with only 2 epochs. I hypothesize this will provide a good balance, improving on the single-epoch SOTA without exceeding the time limit.
